findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded as plaintext in the Lambda function's environment variables, visible in the configuration and readable by anyone with access to the deployment artifacts or console. The source comment confirms these are secrets; even example values here establish a credential-leak pattern (CWE-798).

The function runs nodejs12.x, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Executing on an unsupported runtime leaves the function exposed to unpatched vulnerabilities (CWE-1104).
